_about: Aurora: northern lights over a dark sky. Electric green on the inner edges, violet on the outer bars, teal between them, and a slow wave down the cables. Palette only, so it works on any PC: pc-lights derives every light from these colours and leaves the screens alone.
_led_note: All stops are fully saturated: LEDs show green much brighter than a monitor, so the green is pulled towards teal (00ff8a, not 7aff9a) and the violet keeps red low so it doesn't turn pink.
